" Sure! Here are the steps to create a WeakAura that will tell you when the enemy healer is casting in WoW:

  1. Open WeakAuras by typing /wa in the chat or clicking on the WeakAuras icon in the Addons menu.
  2. Click the “New” button to create a new WeakAura.
  3. In the “Trigger” tab, select “Event” and choose “UNIT_SPELLCAST_START” from the drop-down menu.
  4. In the “Unit” field, type “target” to track the spellcasting of your current target.
  5. In the “Spell” field, type the name of the spell you want to track. For example, if you want to track the casting of the enemy’s “Healing Touch” spell, type “Healing Touch” in the field.
  6. In the “Display” tab, choose how you want the WeakAura to appear on your screen. You can choose to display an icon, a progress bar, a text message, or a combination of these.
  7. Customize the appearance of the WeakAura as desired. You can change the size, position, color, and font of the display.
  8. Click “Import” and paste the following code into the import box:"
